_note: Overrides for src/config.js defaults. Every PRD §2 value is configuration, not a constant in code; anything omitted here uses the binding default.

gate._note: robots_mode: 'strict' = the operator directive — any robots.txt failure, incompleteness or error halts every further factor. 'prd' = PRD F-RUN-6/F-RUN-8 — control-file checks (C-1.1, C-1.2, C-5.3) continue.

cap._note: ua_probe stays false by default: probing with vendor UA strings is opt-in, logged, and caveated (R-FETCH-7).

policy._note: Set ai_blocking_intentional when AI blocking is a deliberate licensing decision: C-5.1-b/c then report rather than fail (E-5.1-1), and no unblocking is recommended (F-5.1-3).
